Package com.example.ecolums

Class Club

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.Club
public class Club extends Object
Represents a campus club or department that can participate in team-based sustainability challenges.

Stored in the Firestore collection clubs. Clubs are created by users with the "Club Leader" role. User objects reference a clubId when they join; ProgressTracker aggregates member logs into the club's collective score; Leaderboard ranks clubs in team challenges.

Outstanding issues: Invite-link expiration logic needs a Cloud Function to auto-deactivate expired codes server-side.
